notes: I changed the model to reverse the string and then replace capital `W` with `r`, since both E1 and E5 show `"World"` reversing to `"rorld"` (i.e., the `W` becomes `r`), while lowercase `world` in E5 reverses normally to `dlrow`. This is marked with `?` because only `W` is evidenced; other capitals may or may not be affected.
